decisions.reason: As a door lever handle family close to the core range, it fits the firm's broad portfolio strategy and prior launch commitment, so management is inclined to continue it unless there is clear evidence of persistent failure.

This handle design is near the established business and has already been kept on the website beyond launch, but as a more design-specific item with less visible strategic commitment than a system family it faces a somewhat higher risk of later pruning.

The electronic access system matches the firm's stated move toward digital building organization and was publicly highlighted with distinctive innovation claims, which strengthens commitment and makes withdrawal unlikely absent unmistakably negative results.
